name: 코뿌리
light: At an industrial canyon transit station under afternoon light, front three-quarter standing pose with open empty hands. Silver gray segmented armor and cream chest accent, conical drill-horn motif worn as narrow headband crest; fully human face and hands. Entire head and feet inside frame.
casual: Inside a subterranean cave visitor station at cool midday, inspecting an unlettered topographic relief map on a waist-high table, one open hand indicating a ridge, the other resting beside the map. Amber cave lamps.
Opaque sand cropped sleeveless utility vest over a secure gray fitted bandeau, charcoal cargo trousers below crop, tiny triangular earrings. Bare shoulders arms and midriff.

At an empty ocean rock terrace at golden sunset, sitting sideways on a smooth low rock after a snorkeling trip, one hand setting a compact mask beside her and other hand resting open on her knee, face turned toward viewer, ocean waves below.

Opaque fully lined dark gray athletic two-piece swimsuit with secure wide-strap square-neck top and high-waisted brief, small cream piping and a tiny conical pendant. Bare shoulders arms waist and legs, full intimate coverage.

At an empty outdoor stone amphitheater under blue-hour festoon lights, rehearsing one energetic dance step, both hands open and apart, complete woman and boots visible, tiered stone seating and glowing lanterns.

Opaque cream asymmetric sleeveless short dance dress with fitted gray waistband and angular overlapping skirt panels, charcoal ankle boots; bare shoulders arms upper chest and legs. Tiny silver crest brooch.
